responsibility: This file implements the IPA subsystem for OpenMP declare simd cloning. It parses declare simd clauses into cgraph_simd_clone descriptions, consults target SIMD-clone hooks to choose vector sizes, simdlen, inbranch variants, and ABI details, creates mangled clone declarations and cgraph links, and for defined functions rewrites signatures, return/argument handling, CFG, and GIMPLE bodies so scalar functions gain vectorized callable clones. It also provides the simdclone IPA pass that scans functions and expands all eligible SIMD clones.
same_name_distinction: Implements the SIMD-clone subsystem whose public surface in gcc/omp-simd-clone.h is only expand_simd_clones. This file performs declare simd clause parsing, target hook consultation, clone mangling/creation, and body/signature rewriting, whereas the header merely exposes the entry point.
